posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are STILL the only unbeaten team in the league at 5-0, and now the win total matches her name because triciagloston is baking every opponent into dust.
posts.detail: 788.44 points-for is a league-best by a mile, and yet after 17 editions of me screaming her name, this league still treats her like a middle-tier ghost with a 6-7-1 career record instead of the problem she's become.

posts.headline: Twenty-five editions later, Thicks finally has a blemish, and the fraud alarm I've been ringing for over three weeks is starting to look prophetic.
posts.detail: 4-1 with 624.6 points sounds fine until you remember the 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish — one ring doesn't erase a history of mediocrity, it just delays the reckoning.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is a lost cause at 1-4, and the name has officially become the most accurate branding in fantasy football history.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record with a dead-last 12 average finish isn't variance, it's identity — the untalented tenth keeps living down to the name week after week.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 1-4 disaster has now gone on so long it's outlived the shock value — this is just who Put it in Ra is now.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and league-best 1.5 average finish are being torched in real time, and a 1.9 GPA joke feels almost generous compared to this GM performance.

posts.headline: Sasinci stays mired at 2-3 and Big Head's ring is looking more like a rental than a crown with every passing week.
posts.detail: A 13-15 career record and 5.5 average finish mean the Milk Man's title defense has less foundation than his falsetto — all pedigree, no proof this season.
